dimensions.assessment: Affects state and tribal agencies, lake and pond managers, hunters, and wildlife officials across multiple regional flyways.
dimensions.evidence: identify entities that may take double-crested cormorants, which shall include-- (A) State and Tribal agencies; and (B) entities licensed... hunters; lake managers; and pond managers

dimensions.assessment: Establishes structured frameworks for population control and take methods of double-crested cormorants across regions.
dimensions.evidence: develop a regional management framework for the take of double-crested cormorants for each region covered by a Regional Flyway Council

dimensions.assessment: Requires regular population surveys and framework updates by the Secretary of the Interior, but contains no specific appropriation or spending figures.
Mandates the creation of new regional frameworks, 5-year population surveys, and framework updates by the federal government in coordination with councils and agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 180 days after the date of the enactment of this section, the Secretary... shall develop a regional management framework

dimensions.assessment: Ongoing, recurring duties including continuous regional frameworks and 5-year population surveys and updates.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 5 years after the date of the enactment of this section and every 5 years thereafter, the Secretary... shall carry out a survey

missing_information: Cost estimates or figures for conducting the required population surveys and developing frameworks.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the Department of the Interior to develop regional management frameworks for double-crested cormorants in coordination with Flyway Councils, affecting wildlife management, hunting, and specific environmental factors across multiple regions.
